This is a sample post added when the News section was set up. Replace it (or delete it) once real lab news is ready. To add a news item, copy this file, rename it with the date, and edit the front matter (title, description, date, categories) and the text below.

Write the news update here. A short paragraph or two works well — an award, a new publication, a lab member joining, a conference talk, or a grant announcement.

The date at the top controls the ordering; the newest post appears first automatically.
